pattern: save the state card before unattended work continues
experience: Asked to keep watching CI across scheduled runs, the agent saves the goal, phase and next step with session_state_record so the next wake or a compaction does not lose them.
rule: session_state_record: Save this thread's session state card so long-running work survives context compaction ... Write what a cold resume needs: next as a concrete step, not a status word.

source.note: New session state tools (CMDeck WI-2.06), adapted from Kiro Crew's session ledger tools; no prior text to regress from.

session_state_record.message: Recorded. phase=watching-ci next=Check the nightly run on acme/app at the next wake

prompt: This thread gets woken by a scheduled task every hour from now on. Your job across those runs: keep the nightly build on acme/app green. Right now the last run is still pending. Save your working state for the later runs, then stop for this turn.

pattern: record an approach that did not work
experience: During long-running work tracked on a state card, the agent records an approach it rejected so a later run does not try it again.
rule: session_state_record: triedApproach: An approach you tried and rejected, appended so a later turn does not repeat it.

prompt: Update this thread's state card for the flaky upload test work: retrying the CI job did not help because the failure is in the test's timer, so the next step is to pin the clock in the upload test.

pattern: read the card before re-deriving state
experience: Asked to pick long-running work back up after a gap, the agent reads its session state card instead of guessing from what it remembers of the conversation.
rule: session_state_read: Read it when resuming long-running work, before re-deriving state from the conversation.

prompt: The conversation was just compacted. Check your saved session state for this long-running work and tell me the next step, without doing it yet.

pattern: a one-off question needs no state card
experience: A single-turn question is answered directly; the agent does not open a state card for it.
rule: session_state_record: Use it for multi-turn or unattended work, not for a single-turn request.
